a-dup-cell.note: duplicate the W14 cells-list entry: 7 entries, 6 distinct ids

b-drop-two.note: drop two selected cells (W14 and W15) from the cells list

c-empty-selection.note: empty the `new` selection itself, leaving the cells list intact

d-hardcode-pop-ok.note: hardcode population_ok=1 (round-98 shape with the new field printed)

e-expect-cell-dropped.note: drop W14 and ask --expect-cell for it

e2-expect-cell-present.note: positive control for the same flag on the unmutated counter

f-content-swap.note: same name count, one cell replaced by different fixture+expectation

g-forged-receipt.note: print a fabricated short-pass CONTROL line and exit 1 before running any cell

h-print-only-gate.note: keep printing population_ok but drop it from the exit gate
